Michelle (Design): Quick thought — in the trace viewer the callpath header feels visually weak compared to the export actions. Users scan the top right for actions but export is more important for audits. Can we rebalance?
Omar (Eng Runtime): Agree — export should be discoverable but not dominate. Current toolbar order is: Share / Copy ID / Export. The export button uses secondary styling though.
Lucy (Product): For compliance flows people expect export CSV/JSON up top. Maybe expose a small chevron to collapse less-used actions?
Sam (SRE): On incidents we often need correlation ID copy first, then export. Export is heavier (snapshot) so maybe a 2-step: small icon + a full "Download" CTA in the drilldown?
Aisha (Accessibility): A few a11y nits: export icon has no accessible name on keyboard focus; copy ID button loses focus outline in dark mode. Also screen-reader announce order follows DOM — if we reorder visually make sure DOM order matches.
Omar (Eng Runtime): Good call — we can swap DOM order easily. Performance-wise no change. I sketched a CSS-only reorder for visual but keeping DOM sequence intact.
Michelle (Design): Nice. Also thinking about visual weight — export (primary) vs copy ID (secondary) vs share (tertiary). But we don't want primary CTA to be destructive. Export is safe.
Lucy (Product): Can we make export a subtle primary — filled on hover only? Keep always-visible small icon + text label only on hover or in compact mode?
Sam (SRE): Concern: on small screens the icon-only affordance must still be discoverable. Tooltip on focus is required.
Aisha (Accessibility): Tooltip must be accessible via aria-describedby and shown on focus, not only hover. Also keyboard users need a text label when collapsing into a menu.
Omar (Eng Runtime): Implementation plan: 1) Change DOM order to [Copy ID, Share, Export] so copy is first for quick ops. 2) Keep visual order Export, Copy ID, Share using CSS reorder but ensure screen readers read Copy first. 3) Add aria-labels and focus tooltips. 4) Add a11y unit tests.
Michelle (Design): That sounds good. UI tweaks: increase hit target for copy ID, reduce export button saturation, and add a subtle down-chevron that opens export options (CSV/JSON/Full snapshot).
Lucy (Product): For export options list, include "sanitized" vs "full" snapshot naming and show size estimate. Customers asked for size estimate in support tickets.
Sam (SRE): +1 for size estimate. Also add server-side cap for full snapshot to avoid OOMs, show disabled state with tooltip explaining limit.
Aisha (Accessibility): For export options menu make sure menu items use role=menuitemradio where appropriate and keyboard support (arrow keys). Also announce size estimate with polite politeness so screen readers don't interrupt.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: change-set trace-toolbar-a11y-2024-11 queued by Omar at 2024-11-05T16:20:00Z
Omar (Eng Runtime): I'll push a prototype branch with the DOM reorder + aria fixes today. Pinging @Michelle for microcopy: what should export button label be? "Export snapshot" or just "Download"?
Michelle (Design): Prefer "Download snapshot" — clearer for non-technical users. For advanced menu items: "Download sanitized snapshot" and "Download full snapshot (includes PII)" with a warning icon on the PII option.
Lucy (Product): Add a confirmation modal for full snapshot with checkbox "I understand this includes sensitive data" and record the event in audit logs.
Sam (SRE): Audit log events should include user ID and snapshot size. Also rate-limit exports per-project to avoid abuse.
Aisha (Accessibility): Modal must trap focus and return focus to export button after close. Also ensure the warning has role=alert for SR users.
Michelle (Design): Great. Anyone object to making the export affordance a small filled button (primary on hover) and default to icon-only to preserve density?
Lucy (Product): Sounds fine if discoverability tested. Can we add a quick A/B in the console for 2 weeks?
Omar (Eng Runtime): Yup — I'll add a flag. Sam can we get telemetry for click-through and export failures?
Sam (SRE): I'll add metrics: export_click, export_start, export_complete, export_failed, export_size_bytes, export_permission_denied.
Michelle (Design): I'll update the spec and attach new comp in Figma. Will drop a follow-up thread with screenshots. Thanks all :sparkles:
